entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;

entries.title: Psalms 64:3
segments: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,

entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, [say they], a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory.
